svg.title: A decision at the gate, with execution and outcome unestablished
svg.desc: Stop the decision marker before the one-way gate. The cached substitute remains beyond; no crossed gate or result arrow may invent execution or outcome. Visual distinction: A ratchet edge and an unpressed control identify a one-way action. No crossing arrow or activated state establishes an outcome.
